about_text: As a Brazilian-Korean-American therapist, I provide culturally sensitive care tailored to each individual's background and goals. My practice is built on honesty, compassion, and evidence-based approaches. I work collaboratively with clients to help them reconnect with their strengths, process difficult experiences, and create meaningful change. In my off time, I love writing music, cooking, and spending time with my husband, family, and our funny cat, Linus.
